methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Sage Geosystems is a Series B-stage climate and energy company founded by Cindy Taff and Lance Cook. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company operating in the same sector at equivalent or adjacent development stages, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the company's $114M total raised as a proxy base value, applying a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-subsequent-stage progression, yielding $217M. Peer-median methodology references valuations of three same-sector, same-stage peers: KoBold Metals at $3.0B, Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B, and Amogy at $700M, producing a median implied value of $1.0B against a range of $700M to $3.0B.

The two methods support a triangulated valuation range of $184M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median point of $608M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around near-term funding availability, technology commercialization timelines, and sector-level capital deployment velocity. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor grounded in recent capital inflows, while peer-median captures upside embedded in comparables valued at later stages or with more advanced deployment metrics. Key uncertainties include the company's specific technology readiness level relative to the peer set and the sustainability of current Climate & Energy sector valuations.
